title: rate_limiter evicts idle entries O(n) on every hot-path call
description: In crates/core/src/rate_limiter.rs, check_and_consume() scans the entire HashMap on every invocation to evict entries idle for more than 1 hour. Under high connection rates with many distinct source IPs (DDoS scenario), the map can grow large and the per-call O(n) scan becomes a CPU bottleneck, competing with the rate limiting it is meant to enforce. Fix: use a periodic background task (tokio::time::interval) or an LRU structure to amortize eviction cost.
